---
title: "About the Data"
---

## Source

All results come from the [NAEP Data Service API](https://www.nationsreportcard.gov/api_documentation.aspx)
(`GetAdhocData` endpoint) for the 2024 NAEP mathematics and reading assessments at grades 4 and 8.
The script `R/fetch_naep.R` queries the API and caches results to
`data/naep_tuda_ses.csv`; the site pages read that file. To refresh the data, run:

```bash
Rscript R/fetch_naep.R
quarto render
```

Requests use these parameters:

| Parameter | Values |
|---|---|
| `subject` / `subscale` | `mathematics` / `MRPCM` (composite), `reading` / `RRPCM` (composite) |
| `grade` | 4, 8 |
| `Year` | 2024 |
| `variable` | `SESCAT` (SES index, 3 components, categorized); `TOTAL` (all students) |
| `stattype` | `MN:MN` (average scale score), `RP:RP` (percent of students), `ALC:AB` (% at or above Basic), `ALC:AP` (% at or above Proficient) |
| `jurisdiction` | `NP` (National public), `NL` (Large city), and the 26 TUDA district codes |

## The NAEP SES index

NAEP began reporting a socioeconomic status (SES) index with the 2024 assessments.
This site uses the **3-component index** (`SESCAT`), which is available at both grades 4 and 8. It combines:

1. the student's economically disadvantaged status,
2. the percentage of students in the student's school classified as economically disadvantaged, and
3. the number of books in the student's home (student-reported).

A 4-component version (`SESCATP`) that adds the highest level of parental education is available only at grades 8 and 12,
so it is not used here. Index scores are grouped into Low, Middle, and High SES categories by NAEP.
See the [NAEP SES Index dashboard](https://www.nationsreportcard.gov/dashboards/sesindex/) and
[NAGB's overview](https://nagb.gov/naep/the-2024-nations-report-card/ses-on-nations-report-card.html) for details.

## Districts

The Trial Urban District Assessment (TUDA) reports NAEP results for large urban school districts.
The 26 districts assessed in 2024 are compared with **National public** (all public schools in the
nation) and **Large city** (public schools in cities with populations of 250,000 or more).

## Caveats

- **Suppressed estimates.** Where NAEP reporting standards were not met, the API returns a
  placeholder value (999) with `isStatDisplayable = 0`. These are shown as missing. High SES
  results are suppressed in several districts with few High SES students, and Denver has no
  reportable SES results in 2024.
- **No significance testing.** The API returns point estimates without standard errors. Differences
  shown here have not been tested for statistical significance; use the
  [NAEP Data Explorer](https://www.nationsreportcard.gov/ndecore/xplore/NDE) for that.
- **Scale comparisons.** Mathematics and reading are reported on separate scales, so score
  differences should not be compared across subjects. Grade 4 and grade 8 results are not
  directly comparable either.
- **Rounding.** Values are rounded for display; gaps are computed from unrounded estimates.
